name: Eclipse Shadow-Fiends
identity: The only phantom army: void-spectres, reaper-knights and wailing hosts. Their bodies ignore armour penetration (a WARD instead of ARM: 5+ for troops, 4+ for elites and Leaders), they terrify what they charge, and each round one unit vanishes into the umbra and reappears elsewhere.

rules.name: Ethereal Phase-Form · Wave of Terror
rules.description: Ethereal: Eclipse units have no ARM save; instead they have the WARD shown on their datasheet (5+ troops, 4+ elites/Leaders, 5+ for Class 4–5), which no PEN can worsen, and they are [STEALTH] against attacks from more than 12″. Wave of Terror: when an Eclipse unit ends a Charge, pick 1 engaged enemy unit: it gets −1 to Hit in melee until the End of Round.

rules.name: Gamble — Phase-Walk
rules.description: When a unit activates: it moves through models and terrain and gets +2″ to its Charge roll this activation, but it loses its WARD until it next activates. (Risk: exposure.)

detachments.name: Midnight Procession
detachments.playstyle: Disappear and reappear: the umbra army.

rules.name: Vanishing into the Umbra
rules.description: At the End of Round, pick 1 unengaged Eclipse unit: remove it and set it up anywhere more than 8″ from all enemies.

enhancements.name: Shroud of Midnight
enhancements.description: **Phantasm Lord on Spectral Steed** only. The attached unit is [STEALTH] at all ranges.

enhancements.name: Void-Lantern
enhancements.description: **Lantern-Warden** only. Units set up by the Umbra within 6″ of him heal D3 MIGHT.

stratagems.name: Fade from Sight
stratagems.effect: It is [STEALTH] at all ranges for the attack.

stratagems.name: Return from the Umbra
stratagems.turn: A unit is set up by the Umbra
stratagems.effect: It may Charge in Round order as if it had moved.

stratagems.name: Grasp of the Dead
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit Falls Back from an Eclipse unit
stratagems.effect: It suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+.

detachments.name: Soul-Reapers
detachments.playstyle: Scythes and blades: kill fast before the WARD fails.

rules.name: Frightful Touch
rules.description: Eclipse melee Hit rolls of 6 auto-wound ([IMPALING HITS]).

enhancements.name: Harvester's Scythe
enhancements.description: **Knight-Phantasm** only. +1 Damage on a round he charged.

enhancements.name: Reaper's Mark
enhancements.description: **Eclipse Reapers** only. Melee Hit rolls of 5+ auto-wound.

stratagems.name: Reap
stratagems.turn: A unit is selected to Fight

stratagems.name: Terror Incarnate
stratagems.effect: Wave of Terror applies to every engaged enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Spectral Fury
stratagems.turn: A unit is below Starting Strength
stratagems.effect: +1 Attack in melee until the End of Round.

detachments.name: Spectral Host
detachments.playstyle: The dead keep coming: lanterns, choirs and endless shades.

rules.name: Endless Dead
rules.description: Soul-Tethered Summons can be used twice per round; Void-Shades return D3 slain models at the End of Round within 9″ of a Leader.

enhancements.name: Wailing Crown
enhancements.description: **Banshee Wailer-Queen** only. Friendly units within 6″ are [STEALTH] at all ranges.

stratagems.name: Rise Again
stratagems.effect: Return a destroyed Class 1 unit at half strength within 6″ of a Leader.

stratagems.name: Chill of the Grave
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit within 6″ of a Leader activates

stratagems.name: Wail of the Host
stratagems.effect: The charging unit suffers −1 to Hit until the End of Round.
